title: View or edit a unit file
summary: Display the contents of a systemd unit file or open it in an editor for modification. Use 'cat' to view and 'edit' to modify.

steps.explain: Use systemctl with the cat or edit action and the name of the unit.

placeholders.name: ACTION
placeholders.description: The action to perform: cat (to view) or edit (to modify).

placeholders.name: UNIT
placeholders.description: The name of the service unit.

rollback.explain: If you edited the file, revert your changes in the editor or restore from backup. Then run daemon-reload.

warnings: Editing unit files incorrectly can prevent services from starting. Always back up files before editing.
